root_cause_analysis.mechanism: The generate pipeline (Dependency.tcl callbacks such as update_gui_pll->cal_onlyacbkby and update_sysclk_loc) reads <IP_EXPORT_PATH>/<comp>_adc.log, where IP_EXPORT_PATH is the generation staging dir. That file is an INPUT produced normally by the GUI's ADC 'check/apply' step (the GUI writes <export>/<comp>_adc.log; reference artifact closure seen in 002820 vendor/ip).
root_cause_analysis.missing_cli_equivalent: no registered CLI command materializes <comp>_adc.log for this flow: read_adc / read_ip_adc both fail 'USR-8321 Read IP adc error, cannot find ip model according to IP name ddrmc_x32'; export_ip_pins/probe attempts no-op; setting CONFIG.PH1P_IO_ASSIGN does not trigger the drc_check pass (PH1P_IO_ASSIGN has no dependency callback; the callbacks hang off PH1P_AC_BYTE/PH1P_DRC_CHECK which are computed params)
root_cause_analysis.tool_ordering_issue: at generate the tool cleans the staging dir and then reads the adc.log from it before anything recreates it (first-time generate on a fresh project cannot pass; a previously GUI-checked instance has the file only in the export root which does not get copied into staging)
